title: Regional model supply & latency risk scan: prioritize fallback models and procurement triggers
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a prioritized map of regional model supply vulnerabilities (availability, latency, cost) and recommend a small set of fallback model variants and procurement triggers for Dedicated & Private customers. Background: Recent customer signals show sensitivity to regional latency spikes when preferred models are throttled or unavailable. This ticket scopes research, lightweight experiments, and a procurement playbook that ties model fallback decisions to measurable triggers (e.g., 95th pct token latency > target, model availability < 90% in region). Deliverables: 1) Risk matrix by region + model family, 2) Ranked fallback model pairs with compatibility notes (quantization, API differences), 3) Procurement trigger definitions and runbook for SRE/Capacity, 4) Customer communication template for enterprise accounts, 5) Short experiment plan and dashboard metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Risk matrix covering NA / EU / APAC for top 12 models used by customers
Fallback model list with compatibility notes and an estimated perf/cost delta per 1k tokens
Procurement triggers defined as concrete SLO thresholds and automated alert actions
Runbook draft reviewed by SRE and Dedicated product leads
Experiment plan implemented on Canary fleet with baseline telemetry recording
tasks: Inventory top models by region (usage, fail-rate, latency distribution) using billing and trace logs
Interview sales + CSMs to capture enterprise model-lock and SLA expectations
Run 3 synthetic latency/availability tests across regions for each candidate model
Estimate cost delta for each fallback pairing (token cost + GPU throughput impact)
Draft procurement trigger thresholds and define alerting actions for Capacity team
Create a canary experiment on Dedicated to verify fallback behavior and rollback
Prepare customer-facing FAQ and email template for enterprise incidents
